thread.title: FY2019 Earnings Forecast for Apple Issued By KeyCorp (AAPL)

author: John. R. Edwardson
title: FY2019 Earnings Forecast for Apple Issued By KeyCorp (AAPL)
text:
Posted by John. R. Edwardson
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) – Research analysts at KeyCorp raised their FY2019 earnings per share estimates for Apple in a note issued to investors on Tuesday, May 1st. KeyCorp analyst A. Hargreaves now expects that the iPhone maker will earn $12.71 per share for the year, up from their previous estimate of $12.64. KeyCorp has a “Equal Weight” rating on the stock. KeyCorp also issued estimates for Apple’s Q4 2019 earnings at $2.94 EPS. Get Apple alerts:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. Apple had a return on equity of 39.33% and a net margin of 21.55%. The company had revenue of $61.14 billion for the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. During the same period in the previous year, the business earned $2.10 EPS. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. A number of other analysts also recently commented on AAPL. Atlantic Securities set a $185.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “neutral” rating in a research note on Wednesday. UBS set a $190.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, January 5th. Sanford C. Bernstein reissued a “neutral” rating and issued a $170.00 price objective on shares of Apple in a research note on Thursday, April 26th. Morgan Stanley reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $205.00 price objective (up previously from $200.00) on shares of Apple in a research note on Tuesday, January 23rd. Finally, HSBC set a $204.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Tuesday, January 30th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have issued a hold rating, thirty-three have issued a buy rating and two have issued a strong buy rating to the company. The stock currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus target price of $203.58.
AAPL stock traded up $7.47 during midday trading on Thursday, hitting $176.57. 66,451,262 shares of the company’s stock were exchanged, compared to its average volume of 36,329,500. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. Apple has a 12-month low of $142.20 and a 12-month high of $183.50. The company has a market capitalization of $858,015.69, a PE ratio of 19.17, a P/E/G ratio of 1.29 and a beta of 1.26.
A number of institutional investors and hedge funds have recently made changes to their positions in AAPL. Truepoint Inc. raised its holdings in Apple by 15,559.4% in the third quarter. Truepoint Inc. now owns 4,436,774 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,437,000 after buying an additional 4,408,441 shares during the last quarter. Harding Loevner LP boosted its position in shares of Apple by 784,734.3% during the third quarter. Harding Loevner LP now owns 3,296,304 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $188,966,000 after acquiring an additional 3,295,884 shares during the last quarter. Mackenzie Financial Corp boosted its position in shares of Apple by 270.5% during the fourth quarter. Mackenzie Financial Corp now owns 1,995,595 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $337,715,000 after acquiring an additional 1,457,017 shares during the last quarter. Atlantic Trust Group LLC boosted its position in shares of Apple by 36.2% during the third quarter. Atlantic Trust Group LLC now owns 3,641,534 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $561,233,000 after acquiring an additional 968,385 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Comerica Bank boosted its position in shares of Apple by 180.0% during the first quarter. Comerica Bank now owns 1,489,006 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $257,300,000 after acquiring an additional 957,144 shares during the last quarter. Hedge funds and other institutional investors own 61.18% of the company’s stock.
In other Apple news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of the stock in a transaction on Friday, April 13th. The stock was sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total value of $6,833,048.52. Following the transaction, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The sale was disclosed in a filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through this link . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of the stock in a transaction on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total value of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last 90 days, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock worth $21,336,201. 0.08% of the stock is owned by corporate insiders.
Apple declared that its Board of Directors has authorized a share buyback program on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to buy up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback programs are usually an indication that the company’s board believes its shares are undervalued.
The firm also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Investors of record on Monday, May 14th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. The ex-dividend date is Friday, May 11th. This is a positive change from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a yield of 1.65%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio is 27.36%.
Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. Apple Apple
